title: Lesson Allocation – Transfer Order – Individual student removal and downstream consistency
description: AC-3, AC-6 — End-to-end — Transfer removes an Individual Student from the previous-location outside lesson and keeps all downstream views consistent.
preconditions:
- Individual Student A has an individual Lesson Allocation at Location A from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31
- Location A has sessions on 2026-06-20 and 2026-06-21, with a Lesson Report Detail on 2026-06-21
- Location A Lesson Allocated is 3 before the Transfer
- Transfer ends Location A on 2026-06-20 and starts Location B on 2026-06-21
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff submits Transfer Order"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location A lesson"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location A Lesson Allocation"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location A lesson report"
5. "BO Staff opens the Location A lesson detail"
6. "Individual Student A opens the Learner App schedule"
steps_result:
1. "The Location A Lesson Allocation ends on 2026-06-20 and the Location B Lesson Allocation starts on 2026-06-21"
2. "Individual Student A is removed from the Location A lesson"
3. "Lesson Allocated is 2 and status reflects the remaining sessions"
4. "Individual Student A has no Lesson Report Detail"
5. "Individual Student A is absent from the student list"
6. "The Location A lesson and report are absent"

title: Lesson Allocation – Cancel Transfer – Individual student remains removed and downstream data remains absent
description: AC-3, AC-6 — State transition — Cancel Transfer restores the prior LA duration without re-adding the previously removed Individual Student Session or downstream data.
preconditions:
- Individual Student A has a submitted Transfer from Location A to Location B
- The Transfer ended the Location A Lesson Allocation on 2026-06-20 and removed Individual Student A from the Location A lesson on 2026-06-21
- Individual Student A has no Location A Lesson Report Detail on 2026-06-21
- Location A Lesson Allocated is 2 after the session removal
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff cancels Transfer Order"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens the previous Location A lesson"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location A Lesson Allocation"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location A lesson report"
5. "BO Staff opens the Location A lesson detail"
6. "Individual Student A opens the Learner App schedule"
steps_result:
1. "The Location A Lesson Allocation end date is restored and the Location B Lesson Allocation is deleted"
2. "Individual Student A is not re-added to the lesson"
3. "Lesson Allocated remains 2 and no duplicate Individual Student Session is created"
4. "Individual Student A has no Lesson Report Detail"
5. "Individual Student A remains absent from the student list"
6. "The previous-location lesson and report remain absent"
